name: Estonia's state ferries to Muhu, Saaremaa and Hiiumaa, trucks
law: Regulation nr 120 of 25.09.2015 of the minister on the ferry prices on the Kuivastu–Virtsu, Rohuküla–Heltermaa and Sõru–Triigi lines, version in force (2026-09-14 publication), annex in the wording of 21.12.2023: the ticket of a truck over 3,500 kg Kuivastu–Virtsu 16.00 EUR, Rohuküla–Heltermaa 18.00 EUR, Sõru–Triigi 22.00 EUR; § 6: × 1.2 for departures towards the islands (Virtsu–Kuivastu, Rohuküla–Heltermaa) on Fridays from 13:00 and back on Sundays from 13:00, rounded to 5 cents; × 1.5 over 2.6 m wide and × 2.0 over 4 m high (not applied: a truck within 2.55 m and 4 m). The regulation doesn't say whether VAT is in the prices; they are taken as it sets them. Residents' prices aren't used. Ports at OpenStreetMap's ferry terminals (else the place), priced where the line goes out on OpenStreetMap's car ferry line.
